discoveries.text: secdev/scapy's CONTRIBUTING requires an AI-Assisted: yes/no (tool) trailer on every commit, adapted from Wireshark's AI policy.
On a slots=True dataclass, Cls.field is a slot descriptor rather than the default value. Read defaults from an instance.

Scapy needs no libpcap/Npcap to read or write capture files, but building ARP() / Ether() without explicit MACs makes it resolve a local interface, which fails on Windows without Npcap. Tests set MACs explicitly.
Headless Edge screenshots do not advance SMIL animation clocks reliably for SVGs in ; seeking with pauseAnimations() / setCurrentTime() gives exact frames.
GitHub Actions runs that push to the same branch race; a concurrency group queues them.
DNS labels can carry arbitrary bytes, including terminal escape sequences; tools that print query names should escape them.

Hex-encoded plain text averages ~3.2–3.35 bits/char of Shannon entropy, random hex ~3.9 (max 4.0). A 3.5 threshold misses realistic DNS exfiltration; pcap-triage uses 3.0 plus length and unique-count conditions.
False positives of interval-regularity tests on irregular traffic fall with event count (2.5 % at 8 events, 0 % at 30 in 200 trials): minimum event count is the main precision control.
Uniform ±j jitter gives a MAD of about j/2 of the interval; a 0.2 MAD/median threshold catches ±30 % jitter 96 % of the time and ±40 % only 70 %.
SigmaHQ/sigma triages fast (2 unassigned open issues in the whole tracker); first contributions are more likely found by reviewing rules in a familiar area.
Sigma rule Suspicious DNS Query with B64 Encoded String matched only ==., missing single-padded base64 (one third of encodings). Fix prepared locally.
